assessment_basis: Repository README, architecture, source, tests and CI definitions were inspected for the recorded gates. The full project test matrix was not re-run as part of this maturity adoption; this is not a new CI certification.

evidence.claim: Defines Reaper's language, users, supported runtimes and current native-parity limitations.
Documents language, runtime, compiler and tooling boundaries.
Provides the repository security and vulnerability-reporting policy.
Defines the native C17 build surface alongside the reference runtime.
Runs the project test suite, example execution and contract validators.
Provides the package entry point that dispatches to the Reaper CLI.
Contains regression tests for parsing, runtime, modules, tools and integration behavior.
Provides a runnable .rpr example used by the CI execution path.
Defines versioned project capabilities and explicit integration evidence across the ecosystem.
Validates the unified project contract and its versioned boundaries.
Runs project tests, example execution and project-contract validation in CI.

next_gate: Compile and execute a declared .rpr subset through the native compiler/runtime on its declared targets.
Add reference/native parity fixtures and versioned ABI compatibility tests.
Record reproducible target builds and measured CPU, memory and resource budgets.
